launch_programme.success_metric: Signed contract and architecture document produced within 2 weeks of start

launch_programme.milestone: MVP platform with Canvas integration live
launch_programme.success_metric: Working integration pulling live data from at least 1 Canvas instance

launch_programme.milestone: First pilot school onboarded and using platform
launch_programme.success_metric: School staff trained and data flowing for more than 2 weeks
dependencies: MVP platform with Canvas integration live

launch_programme.milestone: 3 pilot schools live with measurable retention data
launch_programme.success_metric: All 3 schools active and baseline dropout metrics established
dependencies: First pilot school onboarded and using platform

launch_programme.milestone: 8 paying customers signed for Year 1 target
launch_programme.success_metric: 8 signed annual contracts totalling over 400k EUR ARR
dependencies: 3 pilot schools live with measurable retention data

prerequisite_conditions: GDPR Data Processing Impact Assessment completed and approved before any student data is processed
At least 2 signed letters of intent from business schools before committing to full platform build
500k EUR seed funding secured to cover 12-month runway without revenue dependency
capital_plan: Raise 500k EUR pre-seed round from angel investors with EdTech or higher education background. Use for 12 months runway covering team of 4, cloud infrastructure, and sales activities. Target close by Month 2 to avoid delaying CTO hire. If pilot results strong by Month 9, begin Series A preparation targeting 2-3M EUR.
critical_path_item: CTO hire — everything downstream (MVP, pilot, revenue) depends on having technical leadership in place

contingency_scenarios.scenario: CTO hire takes more than 3 months
contingency_scenarios.response: Engage contract CTO from EdTech agency while continuing permanent search

contingency_scenarios.scenario: First pilot school churns within 60 days
contingency_scenarios.response: Conduct exit interview and pause remaining pilots until root cause fixed

contingency_scenarios.scenario: Seed funding not secured by Month 2
contingency_scenarios.trigger: No term sheet by end of Month 2
contingency_scenarios.response: Alex self-funds 3 months at reduced scope with contractor CTO only

exit_conditions: Wind down if after 18 months fewer than 3 paying customers AND no measurable retention improvement AND seed funding exhausted

assumptions_used.statement: 500k EUR seed round achievable for EdTech in current EU market
assumptions_used.source_detail: Based on 2024-2025 EU EdTech seed round benchmarks

assumptions_used.statement: CTO can be hired within 2 months
Series A achievable at 8-10M pre-money if 8+ customers signed
assumptions_used.source_detail: Based on comparable B2B SaaS Series A rounds in EU

uncertainties: Whether angel investors with EdTech focus are available in current market
Whether 12-month runway is sufficient given potential sales cycle delays
